Watch Chandragupta Maurya Episode - 44 now!
Synopsis :
Chandragupta gets emotional after reuniting with his mother. He asks Mura to reveal everything about Pipliwan. Mura reveals to him that twelve years ago, Pipliwan was one of the most prosperous kingdoms under the leadership of her husband, Chandravardhan. She tells him that the Magadha empire used to envy the Pipliwan kingdom as they failed several attempts to subjugate Pipliwan. She continues to reveal about the treachery of Dhananand and tells him about the incident when Dhananand came to Pipliwan kingdom with a friendship proposal.
